SPY.resolution: Khoo's flow/positioning/seasonality evidence (de-grossing, midterms, breadth) argues near-bottom and conflicts with the market prior's very-bearish read (72% Dec hike, 74% ceasefire-break, 44.5% hot CPI). Resolution: the two describe different drivers — Khoo addresses market structure and earnings (short-term flows), not the Fed-rehike/CPI macro regime that the odds encode. We accept the flow evidence as shrinking the severity of downside (bearish, not very-bearish) while keeping policy/geopolitical risk as the dominant constraint. If the Dec hike materializes alongside hot CPI, seasonality historically loses to policy shocks (2018 analogue).

QQQ.resolution: Short-term rotation-out evidence (qqq-1) vs fundamental-intact evidence (qqq-3) genuinely conflict; both kept. Resolution: rotation is a flow phenomenon (weeks), fundamentals a valuation phenomenon (quarters). For the 90-day view the flow leg dominates while Fed-hike odds (already in prior) suppress multiples — posterior stays near neutral, slightly above the pre-evidence market wash because earnings breadth data is the strongest verified fact in the set.
